---
name: Statutory Feature / Extension Request
about: Suggest a new compliance pattern, rule, or architectural module
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Statutory Ground / Legal Reference**
Which section of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 or DPDP Rules, 2025 does this relate to?
(e.g., Section 9(1) Parental Consent, Section 10 Significant Data Fiduciary, Rule 7 Breach Reporting)

**Describe the Feature or Pattern**
A clear and concise description of the engineering pattern or module you would like to see added.

**Why is this needed?**
Explain the engineering challenge or compliance gap this addresses.

**Proposed Implementation or Architecture**
Any ideas on how to implement this cleanly (APIs, schemas, OPA policies, cryptographic patterns)?
